title: localconfig.vdf with mode 0444: legacy and port both fail to write, but they fail at different steps (backup vs write) and log different lines
culprit: steam/launch_options.rs set_launch_options + backup.rs (backup copy of a read-only file / restore path)
suggested_fix: mirror legacy order: copy2 backup first (this succeeds for a read-only source), then open(config,'w') fails -> log 'Error updating launch options: [Errno 13] ...' and restore the backup (which itself fails on the read-only target: legacy logs that too)
